The reading audits are the author's Python ports of the Kotlin builder; no Kotlin cross-check was run.

The scope audits do not attribute reads made through shell commands or Python, so they list cards and other files as unread that the reports say were read; the author checked those claims against the session events.

Both initial runs made one recursive PowerShell listing of their own packet directory (6,593 files, including the repo context corpus) and read their assignment prompt file, which the audits flag as a path outside the packet; confirm-claude's audit flags two overlapping tool calls (max in flight 2), which its report discloses. confirm-gpt's audit has no flag.

Each confirmation ran as a fresh agent of the same model family, not a later turn of the initial agent; it was handed its family's initial report and the original packet, so it had no memory of its earlier reading.
